entities.summary: Laurent Lokoli is a French professional tennis player. Lokoli plays primarily ATP Challenger and ITF events. He has a career-high ATP singles ranking of No. 167 achieved on 27 February 2023 and a doubles ranking of No. 371 achieved on 3 November 2014.
